scientific_integrity: Infinite proof supplied by cotree induction with explicitly stated boundary terms. Exhaustive finite checks supplement rather than replace the proof. Construction matches lower bound but no uniqueness claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to open adjacency traces in finite simple undirected cographs with at least one named parameter; not closed neighborhoods, arbitrary first-order depth or other graph classes. Targeted comparisons do not exclude every historical equivalent; independent mathematical and priority audits have not been performed.
title: A sharp two-per-parameter bound for one-point adjacency types of finite cographs
